inclusion_rule: Studies that decode speech or text from a non-acoustic speech signal (articulatory imaging, EMA/PMA, EMG, lip or face video, neural recordings) with one model shared across speakers that is conditioned on a per-speaker or per-utterance embedding (x-vector, i-vector, d-vector/GE2E, speaker-encoder output, learned subject embedding). Boundary: acoustic-only systems, audio-visual enhancement or separation with noisy audio at test, speaker embeddings used only as an output-similarity metric, and reviews are excluded (they inflate the pattern match, an upper bound); versions count once.
